A flexible layout configurable with pattern string. The goal of this class 41 * is to {@link #format format} a {@link LoggingEvent} and return the results 42 * in a {@link StringBuffer}. The format of the result depends on the 43 * conversion pattern. 44 *

45 * 46 *

The conversion pattern is closely related to the conversion 47 * pattern of the printf function in C. A conversion pattern is 48 * composed of literal text and format control expressions called 49 * conversion specifiers. 50 * 51 *

Note that you are free to insert any literal text within the 52 * conversion pattern. 53 *

54 55

Each conversion specifier starts with a percent sign (%) and is 56 followed by optional format modifiers and a conversion 57 character. The conversion character specifies the type of 58 data, e.g. category, priority, date, thread name. The format 59 modifiers control such things as field width, padding, left and 60 right justification. The following is a simple example. 61 62

66	   Category root = Category.getRoot();
67	   root.debug("Message 1");
68	   root.warn("Message 2");
69
70 would yield the output 71 
72	   DEBUG [main]: Message 1
73	   WARN  [main]: Message 2
74
75 76

Note that there is no explicit separator between text and 77 conversion specifiers. # Log Plus

LogPlus is a framework to extend current java log framework, LogPlus is based on [logback](https://logback.qos.ch/) framework.
It's pretty cool, and extendable with most java log frameworks.

This framework provides features which can be used in different purposes, it currently supports logback, slf4j, log4j2, log4j1.2.17.

## features
1. integrate with servlet, override servlet [dofilter function](https://tomcat.apache.org/tomcat-5.5-doc/servletapi/javax/servlet/Filter.html) to get extra message from http request
2. provide checkpoint service, checkpoint service set performance check point inside application
3. security, for sensitive information MaskService provide a way to mask string with designed pattern, also HashService hide indicated key from http request with hash method
4. event, EventService is designed for the purpose of tracing, continuously trace activities/actions happened/generated inside production service

## usage
1. requirement:
    1. logback packages (logback-classic, logback-core, slf4j-api)
    2. commons-beanutils
    3. commons-codec ( 1.4 or above)
    4. commons-lang
    
2. configuration:
    1. [logback.xml](src/main/resources/logback.xml) file, change to your desire, an example provided in this repository
    2. [web.xml](src/main/resources/web.xml) file, add listener, filter, filter-mapping, context-param for customized config
    3. customized config file (see [logx.properties](logx.properties) as an example), default config file (see [logx-default.properties](src/main/resources/logx-default.properties)) will be used if no config property file exist/find 
    
    ---
    > LogPlus puts some special key value in to the log based on the property configuration file, 
    the configuration file includes field name, field value - related to logback pattern filed
    > - service name
    > - logx clause (logx.header.name, logx.header.includes, logx.value.hash)
    > - message clause (message.event.begin, message.event.end, message.performance.metric)
    > - component clause (configable components)
    > - resolver clause (configable resolver)
    > - eventType clause (operational.connection, abnormal, transaction, business)
    > - txpath (transaction path)
    
3. http header, for the purpose of passing traceable field to different tier set logx value into header with key and value,
> eg. connection = url.openConnection(); 
>
> connection.setRequestProperty(LogXUtils.getLogXHeaderName(), LogXUtils.getLogXHeaderValue());

<!--
  Log4j 2 equivalent of log4j.properties, demonstrating the LogX log4j2
  integration (com.dawninfotek.logx.extension.log4j2). "packages" makes sure
  the LogX custom pattern converters are discovered even if the annotation

  <Appenders>
    <Console name="CONSOLE" target="SYSTEM_OUT">
      <PatternLayout pattern="%d{yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss} %-5p %c{1}:%L - %m%n" />
    </Console>

    <RollingFile name="FILE" fileName="/tmp/log/test/log4j.log"

        <Pattern>{"timestamp": "%d{yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS zzz}{Canada/Eastern}", "hostname": "${hostName}", "clientIp": "%X{remoteIp}", "appName": "${contextName}", "logLevel ": "%5p", "processId": "%X{processId}", "serviceName": "%X{transactionPath}", "corrId": "%X{uuid}", "sessionId": "%X{sessionId}", "clientId": "%X{userName}", "logMethod": "%M", "thread": "%thread", "logger": "%logger{36}:%L", "message": "%logXMessage", "exception": "%logXThrowable{2}"}%n</Pattern>

</Configuration>

# Log Plus

LogPlus is a framework to extend current java log framework, LogPlus is based on [logback](https://logback.qos.ch/) framework.
It's pretty cool, and extendable with most java log frameworks.

This framework provides features which can be used in different purposes, it currently supports logback, slf4j, log4j2, log4j1.2.17.

## features
1. integrate with servlet, override servlet [dofilter function](https://tomcat.apache.org/tomcat-5.5-doc/servletapi/javax/servlet/Filter.html) to get extra message from http request
2. provide checkpoint service, checkpoint service set performance check point inside application
3. security, for sensitive information MaskService provide a way to mask string with designed pattern, also HashService hide indicated key from http request with hash method
4. event, EventService is designed for the purpose of tracing, continuously trace activities/actions happened/generated inside production service

## usage
1. requirement:
    1. logback packages (logback-classic, logback-core, slf4j-api)
    2. commons-beanutils
    3. commons-codec ( 1.4 or above)
    4. commons-lang
    
2. configuration:
    1. [logback.xml](src/main/resources/logback.xml) file, change to your desire, an example provided in this repository
    2. [web.xml](src/main/resources/web.xml) file, add listener, filter, filter-mapping, context-param for customized config
    3. customized config file (see [logx.properties](logx.properties) as an example), default config file (see [logx-default.properties](src/main/resources/logx-default.properties)) will be used if no config property file exist/find 
    
    ---
    > LogPlus puts some special key value in to the log based on the property configuration file, 
    the configuration file includes field name, field value - related to logback pattern filed
    > - service name
    > - logx clause (logx.header.name, logx.header.includes, logx.value.hash)
    > - message clause (message.event.begin, message.event.end, message.performance.metric)
    > - component clause (configable components)
    > - resolver clause (configable resolver)
    > - eventType clause (operational.connection, abnormal, transaction, business)
    > - txpath (transaction path)
    
3. http header, for the purpose of passing traceable field to different tier set logx value into header with key and value,
> eg. connection = url.openConnection(); 
>
> connection.setRequestProperty(LogXUtils.getLogXHeaderName(), LogXUtils.getLogXHeaderValue());

## 完了報告

**LogPlus (`com.dawninfotek:LogPlus`)** はLog4j 1.xを内部実装ではなく「他のログフレームワークへの統合機能」として使用するライブラリでした（README.mdにも既に「log4j2, log4j1.2.17をサポート」と記載されていました)。そのため、タスク方針に従い **Log4j 1.x統合は残したまま、Log4j 2.x統合を追加** しました。

### 変更内容

1. **`pom.xml`**
   - `org.apache.logging.log4j:log4j-api` / `log4j-core` 2.26.1（最新安定版）を追加(既存の`log4j:log4j:1.2.17`はそのまま維持)
   - `maven.compiler.source/target` を1.6→1.8に引き上げ(既存の`spring-boot-starter`が既にJava 8必須だったため、また現行JDKでは1.6コンパイルが不可能)
   - `spring-boot-starter-logging`経由で入る`log4j-to-slf4j`を除外(これがないとLog4jのプロバイダ選択が競合し、log4j-coreではなくslf4jブリッジ側が使われてしまう問題を確認したため)
   - `maven-compiler-plugin`にLog4j2のアノテーションプロセッサ(`log4j-core`)を設定してプラグイン自動検出用の`Log4j2Plugins.dat`を生成
   - `maven-surefire-plugin`を2.20.1→3.2.5に更新(旧バージョンはJDK 26でクラッシュする既存の問題があり、これがないとテストが実行できなかった)

2. **新規パッケージ `com.dawninfotek.logx.extension.log4j2`**
   - `LogXMessagePatternConverter` — 旧`log4j12`版のメッセージ整形(`\t`除去、`\n`をスペース4つに置換)をLog4j2の`@Plugin`/`LogEventPatternConverter`として再実装。`%logXMessage`という新しい変換ワードとして登録(グローバルな`%m`上書きによる副作用を避けるため)
   - `LogXThrowablePatternConverter` — 旧`LogXThrowableInformationPatternConverter` + `LogXThrowableRenderer`の組み合わせ(スタックトレースを改行なしの1行に平坦化、行数制限オプション対応)を1つのLog4j2プラグインとして統合。`%logXThrowable`として登録

3. **`src/test/resources/log4j2.xml`** — 既存の`log4j.properties`と同等の構成(CONSOLE/FILEアペンダ、ロガーレベル、JSON風パターン)をLog4j2形式で追加。アノテーションプロセッサ生成のプラグインキャッシュにより`packages`属性なしで新変換ワードが自動検出されることを確認済み

4. **`README.md`** に設定ファイル例へのポインタを追記

### 検証
- `mvn clean test` → 6件のテスト全て成功(既存テストのアサーションは無変更)
- 手動でLog4j2 `LogManager`経由のログ出力を検証し、`%logXMessage`/`%logXThrowable{2}`が期待通りJSON構造内で改行除去・スタック平坦化されることを確認

`log4j12`パッケージ配下のソースは一切変更していません(既存のLog4j 1.x統合機能を維持する方針のため)。
